subject: BrightLeaf: MAP & proposed owners/dates

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@brightleaf.com>, Tom Blake <tom@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: BrightLeaf: MAP & proposed owners/dates

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and the Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can lock timelines. Highlights from the call: 
- Primary use case: summary analytics to accelerate provider network decisions; peak inference needs estimated ~300 tokens/request, ~500 requests/min during pilot.
- Success criteria: < 200ms 95th-token latency on production endpoint, < 10% generation cost delta vs baseline, and integration of audit logs for queries.
- Key blockers we flagged: SIEM access for logs, legal review for data residency, and who will own the internal eval criteria.

I attached a version of the MAP (BrightLeaf_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the suggested owners and target dates. Quick asks:
1) Please confirm the internal owners for the three evaluation streams (APP, Data, Security) that I filled in, or update as needed.
2) Can you confirm target completion dates (I proposed Aug 27 for pilot readiness, Sep 10 for internal sign-off)?
3) If you prefer, I can block 30 minutes next week to walk through the plan with whoever owns procurement/security.

Attachments: BrightLeaf_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP), SOW-draft.pdf (scope + high level pricing)

If I don't hear back, I'll follow up later this week — just want to make sure this stays on your radar while it's still fresh.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.com/
